name: El Nasr Housing and Development Company
source: MUTXRI CRON 18 Nov 2026: El Nasr Housing and Development Company, Financial indicators table published on the company's own website (el-nasrhousing.com/Finanical.aspx), columns 2017/2018 through 2023/2024. The table prints revenue from ongoing activity and net profit or loss in EGP thousands; stored here multiplied by 1000 as absolute EGP.
source_note: Two rows only. The issuer's public indicators table prints revenue from ongoing activity and net profit and nothing else, so there is no cost of sales, gross profit, operating profit, finance cost or tax line to carry. Period labels are left exactly as the issuer prints them because the company's financial year is not stated on the table and press reports of its results appear on both a calendar and a July to June basis; labelling these as plain FY2024 would assert a year end the source does not give. Revenue from ongoing activity: 633,242 thousand EGP (2017/2018), 489,802 (2018/2019), 556,560 (2019/2020), 653,331 (2020/2021), 771,622 (2021/2022), 1,192,704 (2022/2023), 1,048,896 (2023/2024). Net profit: 117,728, 120,203, 200,211, 294,247, 407,246, 436,259, 450,371 thousand EGP in the same order. Note that the same table prints total investment of 15,013,938 thousand EGP for 2022/2023 against roughly 1.5 million thousand in the neighbouring years, which is a unit error in that one cell; the revenue and profit columns do not carry that anomaly and were used as printed.
